sourceText:
Garlic Parmesan Twists
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 1, 2009 - 11:31pm

Ingredients




3/4 cup Water
1 teaspoon Salt
1 tablespoon Sugar
2 cups Gold Medal Better for Bread Flour
1 teaspoon Fleischmann's Bread Machine Yeast
 cup Butter or margarine, melted
2 Cloves garlic, finely chopped
2 tablespoons Grated parmesan cheese

Preparation

1 Measure carefully, placing all ingredients EXCEPT butter (or margarine), garlic and parmesan cheese in the bread pan in the order recommended by the manufacturer. 2 Select the Dough/Manual cycle. 3 At the end of the dough cycle, transfer the dough to a large greased bowl and turn greased side up. Cover and let rise in a warm place for about 30 minutes, or until doubled in bulk. Dough is ready if an indentation remains when the dough is touched with the tip of a finger. 4 Grease a cookie sheet. Punch down the risen dough. Divide the dough into 20 equal pieces. Roll each piece into 10"-12" ropes on a lightly floured surface. Pinch two ropes together at one end and twist, starting at pinched end. Tuck the other end under and place the twist on the prepared baking sheet. Repeat with remaining ropes. 5 Mix butter (or margarine) with the garlic and parmesan; brush over twists. 6 Cover and let rise in a warm place for 20-30 minutes, or until doubled. 7 Heat oven to 400x. Bake the twists for 12-15 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm, or cool on wire rack. 8 NOTES : These savory soft breadsticks are a delicious and attractive accompaniment to any meal.
